definitions.explanation: A written acknowledgment that something has been received, especially payment.

examples.japanese: {受取|うけとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受取|うけとり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: Please pick up your package at the counter.

examples.japanese: {受取|うけとり}⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受取|うけとり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦のみ→のみ：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっています→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Only the person themselves can receive the item.

examples.japanese: {受取|うけとり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I specify the date and time for receiving it?

notes:
USAGE: {受取|うけとり} can refer to both the document (receipt) and the act of receiving.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {受取|うけとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a receipt)
- {受取|うけとり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧ (to issue a receipt)
- ⟦{受取|うけとり}{証|しょう}→受取証：27078_uketorishou⟧ (receipt, acknowledgment)
- ⟦{受取|うけとり}{人|にん}→受取人：19162_uketorinin⟧ (recipient, addressee)

WRITING VARIATIONS: Can also be written as {受け取|うけと}り.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧ - receipt (from English, for store purchases)
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧ - official receipt (more formal)
